Municipal Waste Finance in Africa: Collection Contracts, Recycling Revenues and Public Service

A city can contain valuable discarded materials and still lack the money to collect its rubbish. Africa's circular-economy opportunity depends on recognising that difference. Recent collection reforms in Kampala, project preparation in Senegal and South African packaging-finance arrangements show why reliable services need an explicit payer, an accountable operating chain and a fair settlement with the people already recovering materials.
